Cube of Summoning.description:
奇物，珍稀

This Tiny cube looks like a jack-in-the-box. When you wind its crank as a Magic action, a merry tune emits from the box, the lid pops open, a creature appears in the nearest unoccupied space, and the lid closes. The lid can’t otherwise be opened.

Roll on the Cube of Summoning table to determine which spell the cube casts to summon the creature. The spell is cast at level 5 (save DC 17, +9 attack bonus) and doesn’t require Concentration, but you otherwise function as the spell’s caster.

Once the cube summons a creature, the cube can’t do so again until the next dawn.

Gray Bag of Tricks.name: 灰色魔術袋
Gray Bag of Tricks.description:
奇物，非普通

This bag made from gray, rust, or tan cloth appears empty. Reaching inside the bag, however, reveals the presence of a small, fuzzy object.

You can take a Magic action to pull the fuzzy object from the bag and throw it up to 20 feet. When the object lands, it transforms into a creature you determine by rolling on the table that corresponds to the bag’s color. See the Monster Manual for the creature’s stat block. The creature vanishes at the next dawn or when it is reduced to 0 Hit Points.

The creature is Friendly to you and your allies, and it acts immediately after you on your Initiative count. You can take a Bonus Action to command how the creature moves and what action it takes on its next turn, such as attacking an enemy. In the absence of such orders, the creature acts in a fashion appropriate to its nature.

Once three fuzzy objects have been pulled from the bag, the bag can’t be used again until the next dawn.

Hat of Many Spells.name: Hat of Many Spells
Hat of Many Spells.description:
奇物, Very Rare (Requires Attunement by a Wizard)

This pointed hat has the following properties.

Spellcasting Focus. While holding the hat, you can use it as a Spellcasting Focus for your Wizard spells. Any spell you cast using the hat gains a special Somatic component: you must reach into the hat and “pull” the spell out of it.

Unknown Spell. While holding the hat, you can try to cast a level 1+ spell you don’t know. The spell must be on the Wizard spell list, it must be of a level you can cast, and it can’t have Material components costing more than 1,000 GP. Once you decide on the spell, you must expend a spell slot of the spell’s level. Then, to determine whether you cast the spell, make an Intelligence (Arcana) check (DC 10 plus the spell’s level). On a successful check, you cast the spell using its normal casting time, and you can’t use this property again until you finish a Short or Long Rest. On a failed check, you fail to cast the spell and a random effect occurs instead, determined by rolling on the following table.

Any spell you cast from the hat uses your spell save DC and spell attack bonus.

18-18.description: 【戰爭領袖】你可以用魔法動作使你的聲音或訊號清晰傳達至多600呎，持續到你的下個回合結束。

19-19.description: 【浮水】該物品能漂浮在水或其他液體上。你進行游泳的力量（運動）檢定具有優勢。

17-17.description: 【堅不可摧】該物品無法被破壞。必須使用特殊手段才能將其摧毀。

5-6.description: 【守護者】該物品會對你發出警示；若你未陷入失能狀態，則使你的先攻擲骰獲得+2加值。

13-13.description: 【譜曲】每當該物品被敲擊，或被用來擊打敵人時，你會聽見一段古老歌曲的片段。

10-10.description: 【密訊】某則訊息隱藏在該物品的某處。這則訊息可能只在特定時間、某個月相的月光下，或特定地點才看得見。

49-52.description: Instrument of the Bards (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgCanaithMandol]{Canaith Mandolin} or @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgCliLyreInstru]{Cli Lyre})

1-1.description: 聽覺與一般視覺，範圍達30呎

2-2.description: 聽覺與一般視覺，範圍達60呎

4-4.description: 聽覺與黑暗視覺，範圍達120呎

3-3.description: 聽覺與一般視覺，範圍達120呎

15-15.description: An Indifferent @UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmGiantApe000000]{Giant Ape} protects its territory; its primary concern is getting the party to leave.

17-17.description: Three @UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmAllosaurus0000]{Allosauruses} are hunting in the jungle; they are Hostile and treat the party as prey.

16-16.description: A Hostile @UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmTyrannosaurusR]{Tyrannosaurus Rex} is on the hunt and tries to eat the characters.

18-18.description: Two @UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmAnkylosaurus00]{Ankylosauruses} tromp through the forest nearby. They are territorial and aggressive but Indifferent, and they won’t pursue a fleeing party.

19-19.description: A band of humans, including a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmWarriorVeteran]{Veteran Warrior} and eight @UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmWarriorInfantr]{Infantry Warriors}, watch the party. They are Indifferent; they live in the jungle and aren’t used to seeing other people.

20-20.description: Four @UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmMinotaurOfBaph]{Minotaurs of Baphomet} prowl the jungle looking for Humanoids they can capture and bring back to the temple.

27-28.description: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgManualOfGolem]{Manual of Golems} (clay, flesh, iron, or stone)

41-45.description: 一大團共600隻的超大蝴蝶充滿以所選源點為中心、高60呎、半徑30呎的圓柱體。蝴蝶停留10分鐘，在此期間，該效應區域處於&Reference[Heavily Obscured]{重度遮蔽}。

83-87.description: 所選的源點處什麼也沒發生。取而代之的是，你對自己施放@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplInvisibili]{隱形術}。

78-82.description: 所選的源點處什麼也沒發生。取而代之的是，一道繽紛閃爍的光芒從你向外迸發，形成30呎發散區域。區域內的每個生物都必須成功通過一次[[/save con 15]]豁免，否則陷入&Reference[Blinded]{目盲}狀態1分鐘。生物在其每個回合結束時重複進行豁免，豁免成功則結束其身上的效應。

36-40.description: 一場大雨在以所選源點為中心、高120呎、半徑60呎的圓柱體區域內下1分鐘。在此期間，該效應區域處於&Reference[Lightly Obscured]{輕度遮蔽}。

73-77.description: 距離所選源點最近的生物身上長出樹葉。除非被摘下，否則樹葉會在24小時後變成褐色並掉落。

51-55.description: 距離所選源點最近的生物被放大，如同你對其施放了@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplEnlargeRed]{變巨/縮小術}。若目標不是你，且無法受到該法術影響，則改以你為目標。

88-92.description: 所選的源點處什麼也沒發生。取而代之的是，一股共[[/r 1d4*10 #Gems]]顆的寶石（每顆價值1 GP）從魔杖尖端射出，朝所選的源點形成一條長30呎、寬5呎的直線。每顆寶石造成[[/damage 1 type=bludgeoning]]傷害，寶石的總傷害由直線內的所有生物均分。

1-20.description: 你在所選的源點施放一道法術。擲1d10決定法術：骰出1–2為@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplDarkness00]{黑暗術}；3–4為@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplFaerieFire]{妖火術}；5–6為@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplFireball00]{火球術}；7–8為@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplSlow000000]{緩速術}；9–10為@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplStinkingCl]{臭雲術}。

31-35.description: 所選的源點處什麼也沒發生。取而代之的是，你承受[[/damage 1d6 type=psychic]]傷害。

61-64.description: 草地覆蓋一塊半徑60呎的圓形地面，圓心盡可能靠近所選的源點。原本就在該處的草會長到平常的十倍大，並維持過度生長的狀態1分鐘。

26-30.description: 你施放@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplGustofWind]{造風術}。該法術產生的直線從你延伸至所選的源點。

69-72.description: 所選的源點處什麼也沒發生。取而代之的是，你縮小了，如同你對自己施放了@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplEnlargeRed]{變巨/縮小術}，並維持該狀態1分鐘。

98-100.description: 距離所選源點最近的生物進行一次[[/save con 15]]豁免。豁免失敗時，該生物陷入&Reference[Restrained]{束縛}狀態，並開始化為石頭。以此方式處於束縛狀態期間，該生物在其下個回合結束時重複進行豁免。豁免成功則效應結束；豁免失敗則該生物改為陷入&Reference[Petrified]{石化}狀態，取代束縛狀態。石化會持續到該生物被@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplGreaterRes]{高等復原術}法術或類似魔法解除為止。

56-60.description: 一個以魔法形成的生物出現在盡可能靠近所選源點的未佔據空間。該生物不受你控制，依其常態行動，並在1小時後或生命值降至0時消失。擲[[/r 1d4]]決定出現哪種生物。骰出1時，出現犀牛；骰出2時，出現象；骰出3–4時，出現老鼠。

93-97.description: 你對距離所選源點最近的生物施放@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplPolymorph0]{變形術}。擲[[/r 1d4]]決定目標的新形態：骰出1時，新形態為黑熊；骰出2時，新形態為巨黃蜂；骰出3–4時，新形態為青蛙。

46-50.description: 你施放@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplLightningB]{閃電束}。該法術產生的直線從你延伸至所選的源點。

21-25.description: 所選的源點處什麼也沒發生。取而代之的是，你陷入&Reference[Stunned]{震懾}狀態，直到你的下個回合開始前，並相信剛剛發生了某件令人驚嘆的事。

65-68.description: DM選擇的一個物體消失並進入乙太位面。該物體必須既未被穿戴也未被攜帶，位於所選源點120呎內，且任一維度皆不超過10呎。若範圍內沒有這樣的物體，則什麼也沒發生。

3-3.description: The guest is a mercenary, giving you one additional Bastion Defender. The guest doesn’t require a facility to house them, and they stay until you send them away or they’re killed.

2-2.description: The guest requests sanctuary while avoiding persecution for their beliefs or crimes. They depart 7 days later, but not before offering you a gift of [[/award 1d6*100gp]].

1-1.description: The guest is an individual of great renown who stays for 7 days. At the end of their stay, the guest gives you a letter of recommendation (see @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.content.JournalEntry.dmgDmsToolbox000.JournalEntryPage.XpmEG4yalu71L9ed]{Marks of Prestige}).

4-4.description: The guest is a Friendly monster, such as a brass dragon or a treant. If your Bastion is attacked while this monster is your guest, it defends your Bastion, and you lose no Bastion Defenders. The monster leaves after it defends your Bastion once or when you send it away.
一處突然的落差讓你措手不及。進行一次[[/save dex dc=10]]豁免以通過該阻礙。豁免失敗時，你墜落10呎。

2-2.description: 一條溪流或峽谷擋住了你的去路。進行一次[[/save str dc=10]]或[[/save dex dc=10]]豁免（由你選擇）以越過阻礙。豁免失敗時，該阻礙對你而言視為10呎的&Reference[Difficult Terrain]{困難地形}。

5-5.description: 你的路徑經過一叢@UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.content.JournalEntry.dmgDmsToolbox000.JournalEntryPage.lVkdQivhFHqVmxg7#razorvine]{刃藤}。進行一次[[/save dex dc=15]]豁免，或消耗10呎移動（由你選擇）以避開刃藤。豁免失敗時，你承受[[/damage 1d10 type=slashing]]傷害。

1-1.description: 你闖進一個昆蟲群（見《怪物圖鑑》，由DM選擇最合理的昆蟲種類）。該昆蟲群用掉其一個動作，並以你為目標。

6-6.description: 該區域的原生生物注意到了你。（DM選擇適合該地形的生物。）進行一次[[/save wis dc=10]]或[[/save cha dc=10]]豁免（由你選擇）。豁免失敗時，該生物加入追逐，並以你為獵物。

3-3.description: 進行一次[[/save con dc=10]]豁免。豁免失敗時，吹來的沙、泥土、灰燼、雪或花粉會使你陷入&Reference[Blinded]{目盲}狀態，直到你的回合結束。你以此方式目盲期間，你的速度減半。

6-6.description: An Artifact belonging to a god falls into mortal hands.

7-7.description: A titan imprisoned in the Underdark begins to break free, causing terrible earthquakes that are only a hint of the destruction that the titan will cause if it is released.

2-2.description: A band of giants drove away a metallic dragon and took over the dragon’s lair, and the dragon wants to reclaim the lair.

3-3.description: An ancient hero returns from the dead to prepare the world for the return of an equally ancient monster.

4-4.description: An ancient Artifact has the power to defeat or imprison a rampaging titan.

8-8.description: A lich tries to exterminate any spellcasters that approach the lich’s level of power.

10-10.description: Five ancient metallic dragons lair in the Pillars of Creation. If all these dragons are killed, the world will collapse into chaos. One has just been slain.

1-1.description: An ancient dragon is scheming to destroy a god and take the god’s place in the pantheon. The dragon’s minions are searching for Artifacts that can summon and weaken this god.

5-5.description: A god of agriculture is angry, causing rivers to dry up and crops to wither.

9-9.description: A holy temple was built around a portal leading to one of the Lower Planes to prevent any evil from passing through in either direction. Now the temple has come under siege from both directions.

65-66.description: Intended as a death trap to eliminate any creature that enters, perhaps to guard a treasure or to harvest souls for a necromantic rite

41-43.description: Built to house a planar portal but abandoned when creatures or energy from the other side of the portal seeped into the dungeon

7-9.description: Amazingly well preserved ancient city inside a dome encased in volcanic ash, submerged underwater, or entombed in desert sands

56-58.description: Dug as a burrow by a monster that might still live inside

24-26.description: Built beneath a city in catacombs or sewers

70-72.description: Long known as the site of a great miracle or another auspicious event

30-32.description: Built by a religious group to serve as a temple and linked to the energy of other planes of existence

99-100.description: Transformed by multiple events or disasters over the course of centuries

16-18.description: Built as a stronghold but abandoned after it fell to invaders

76-78.description: Made by a powerful spellcaster (perhaps a lich) as a site for magical research and experimentation

39-40.description: Built in or among the branches of a tree

53-55.description: Contains something that led to the downfall of its creators or inhabitants

5-6.description: Abandoned by its original creators when a plague spread through the dungeon

73-75.description: Made by amphibious creatures (such as kuo-toa or aboleths), using water to protect the innermost reaches from air-breathing intruders

33-35.description: Built by dwarves and decorated with enormous dwarven faces that have been defaced by its current inhabitants

13-15.description: Built as a maze, either to protect treasure from intruders or as a gauntlet where prisoners were hunted by monsters

79-81.description: Made by giants at a vast scale

1-1.description: Accident reports are way down.

7-7.description: Some practical joker has been putting rotten eggs in people’s boots.

2-2.description: The leak in the roof has been fixed.

5-5.description: One of your hirelings adopted a stray dog.

6-6.description: You received a lovely letter from a friend.

12-12.description: A coven of hags steals cherished memories from travelers.

13-13.description: A villain seeks powerful magic in an ancient ruin, hoping to use it to conquer the region.

1-1.description: A group of cultists has summoned a demon to wreak havoc in the city.

18-18.description: Rebels or forces of an enemy nation have kidnapped an important noble.

9-9.description: After establishing a lair, a young dragon is trying to earn the fear and respect of other creatures living nearby.

17-17.description: A secretive cult uses spies to heighten tensions between two rival nations, hoping to provoke a war that will weaken both.

15-15.description: A ship carrying a valuable treasure or an evil Artifact sinks in a storm or monster attack.

11-11.description: An enormous monster on display in a menagerie breaks free and goes on a rampage.

8-8.description: A conspiracy of spies, assassins, and necromancers schemes to overthrow a ruler.

7-7.description: A golem intended to serve as a protector has gone berserk and captured its creator.

14-14.description: A scheming aristocrat hosts a masquerade ball, which many guests see as an opportunity to advance their own agendas. At least one shape-shifting monster also attends.

6-6.description: A master thief plans to steal royal regalia.

5-5.description: A monster (perhaps a devil, slaad, or hag) is impersonating a prominent noble to throw the realm into civil war.

16-16.description: A natural disaster was actually caused by magic gone awry or a cult’s villainous plans.

10-10.description: The approach of a lone giant alarms the people of a town, but the giant is simply looking for a place to live in peace.

19-19.description: The descendants of a displaced people want to reclaim their ancestral city, which is now inhabited by monsters.

4-4.description: An Aberration living in the Underdark sends minions to capture people from the surface to turn those people into new minions.

20-20.description: A renowned group of adventurers never returned from an expedition to a famous ruin.

3-3.description: An evil Artifact has transformed a forest into a dismal swamp full of horrific monsters.

2-2.description: A rebel lures monsters to the cause with the promise of looting the king’s treasury.

7-7.description: 月光石（白色帶淡藍色光暈）

8-8.description: 縞瑪瑙（純黑、純白或黑白條紋）

8-8.description: 【權力象徵】該物品曾是王室儀仗的一部分，或是高位官職的徽記。

6-6.description: 【宗教】這件物品曾用於供奉某位特定神祇的宗教儀式，上面帶有宗教符號。

7-7.description: 【不祥】這件物品與某樁重大惡行有關，例如大屠殺或暗殺。其可能有名字，或與曾使用過該物品的惡人緊密相連。

5-5.description: 【預言】該物品是某個預言的一部分：其持有者註定要在未來的事件中扮演關鍵角色。

4-4.description: 【裝飾】該物品是為了紀念某個特殊事件。其表面以鑲嵌的寶石、金或鉑金鑲嵌物，以及金或銀的細絲工藝裝飾。

2-2.description: 【破滅】該物品是為對抗某種特定類型的生物所製，例如異怪或龍類。

3-3.description: 【英雄】某位偉大的英雄曾使用過這件物品。任何了解該物品歷史的人，都期待新的持有者能再續偉業。

1-1.description: 【神秘】該物品是為某個古老的施法者結社所製，並帶有該結社的標誌。

【幸福】你對未來感到幸運且樂觀。蝴蝶與其他無害的生物可能會在該物品附近嬉戲。

2-2.description: 【自信】該物品讓你感到自信滿滿。

7-7.description: 【疼痛】使用該物品時，你會經歷一陣無害的痛楚。

4-4.description: 【易碎】當該物品被持用、穿戴或啟動時，會微微碎裂、磨損、缺角或裂開。此影響不會影響其屬性。

6-6.description: 【變形】該物品會週期性地以細微方式改變外觀。你無法控制這些細微的改變，且這些改變不影響該物品的使用。

8-8.description: 【嫌惡】接觸該物品時你會感到厭惡，且在持有期間會持續感到不適。

5-5.description: 【喧鬧】該物品使用時會發出巨響，例如鏗鏘聲、吼叫聲或迴盪的鑼聲。

6-6.description: The ruler of the realm is sending an emissary to a hostile neighbor to negotiate a truce, and the emissary needs protection.

3-3.description: An adult dragon’s lair is transforming an expanse into an environment inhospitable to the other creatures living there.

12-12.description: During a drought, low water levels in a lake reveal previously unknown ancient ruins that contain a powerful evil.

1-1.description: A portal to the Abyss opens in a cursed location and spews demons into the world.

4-4.description: A long-lost journal describes an incredible journey to a hidden subterranean realm full of magical wonders.

7-7.description: A castle or city has been drawn into another plane of existence.

2-2.description: A band of hunting giants has driven its prey—enormous beasts—into pastureland.

10-10.description: Evil cultists gather from around the world to summon a monstrous god or alien entity.

8-8.description: A storm tears across the land, with a mysterious flying citadel in the eye of the storm.

5-5.description: Cultists hope to persuade a dragon to undergo the rite that will transform it into a dracolich.

9-9.description: Two parts of a magic item are in the hands of bitter enemies; the third piece is lost.

11-11.description: A tyrannical ruler outlaws the use of magic without official sanction. A secret society of spellcasters seeks to oust the tyrant.

8-8.description: An innocent person is being framed for the crimes of a shape-shifting monster.

16-16.description: A hag’s curse is making animals unusually aggressive.

9-9.description: Ghouls are venturing out of the catacombs at night.

12-12.description: To take revenge against a village for an imagined slight, a necromancer has been animating the corpses in the village cemetery.

17-17.description: Bullies have appointed themselves the village militia and are extorting money and food from villagers.

19-19.description: The ruins on the hill near the village lie under a curse, so people don’t go there—except a scholar who wants to study the ruins.

2-2.description: Wererats living in a city’s sewers plot to take control of the governing council.

4-4.description: A pack of gnolls is rampaging dangerously close to local farmlands.

10-10.description: A notorious criminal hides from the law in an old ruin or abandoned mine.

14-14.description: An abandoned house on the edge of town is haunted by Undead because of a cursed item in the house.

7-7.description: Miners discovered an underground ruin and were captured by monsters living there.

1-1.description: A dragon wyrmling has gathered a band of kobolds to help it amass a hoard.

6-6.description: A new sinkhole has revealed a long-buried dungeon thought to hold treasure.

13-13.description: An evil cult is spreading in a village. Those who oppose the cult are marked for sacrifice.

20-20.description: A new captain has taken charge of a band of pirates or bandits and started raiding more frequently.

15-15.description: Creatures from the Feywild enter the world and cause mischief and misfortune among villagers and their livestock.

18-18.description: After a local fisher pulls a grotesque statue from the sea, aquatic monsters start attacking the waterfront at night.

11-11.description: A contagion in a forest is causing spiders to grow massive and become aggressive.

5-5.description: A rivalry between two merchant families escalates from mischief to mayhem.

3-3.description: Bandit activity signals efforts to revive an evil cult long ago driven from the region.

1-1.description: Two monsters have a bitter rivalry; each wants the other to suffer.

5-5.description: One monster cares only for itself and not the rest of the group.

2-2.description: One monster, bullied by the others, hangs back and flees at the first opportunity.

3-3.description: One monster is revered or even worshiped by the others, who will die for it.

6-6.description: One monster bullies the others; it forces them into danger, but they want it defeated.

4-4.description: One monster is admired by the group; its allies try to impress or help it.
A wealthy patron who is aware of the adventurers’ accomplishments writes to them, offering to pay them for their talents.

3-3.description: When the characters arrive in a new city, they find a job board where someone has posted in search of adventurers.

1-1.description: A town crier announces that someone is hoping to hire adventurers.

5-5.description: A citizen in need, who has learned of the adventurers’ accomplishments and kindness, travels miles to find them and implore them for help.

2-2.description: Someone the characters want to impress or need a favor from asks them to deal with the adventure situation.

6-6.description: The adventurers are arrested (on valid or invented charges) and offered a chance to escape punishment by completing a quest.

41-50.description: 與該神器同調期間，你對一種由DM選擇的傷害類型具有抗力。

61-70.description: 與該神器同調期間，你可以從該神器施放一道1環法術（由DM選擇）。施放該法術後，擲1d6。若骰出1–5，則在下個黎明前你無法再以此方式施放該法術。

91-100.description: 與該神器同調期間，你的護甲等級獲得+1加值。

1-20.description: 與該神器同調期間，你獲得一項由DM選擇的技能熟練。

31-40.description: 與該神器同調期間，你對魅惑與恐慌狀態具有免疫。

21-30.description: 與該神器同調期間，你對中毒狀態具有免疫。

51-60.description: 與該神器同調期間，你可以從該神器施放一道戲法（由DM選擇）。

18-20.description: You have the &Reference[Unconscious] condition for [[/r 1d10]] hours; the effect on you ends if you take damage or if another creature takes an action to shake you awake.

1-8.description: You have the &Reference[Stunned] condition for 1 minute; you repeat the saving throw at the end of each of your turns, ending the effect on yourself on a success.

1-1.description: The characters all have a vivid dream that foreshadows elements of the adventure.

2-2.description: While preparing spells, one character receives a quest from a god or patron.

4-4.description: Flames, clouds, smoke, or huge flocks of birds take distinct shapes that portend the adventure situation.

3-3.description: A fortune teller’s reading for one of the characters points to a quest and offers hints about challenges that lie ahead.

6-6.description: Someone who died returns as a ghost and haunts the characters. The ghost prompts the characters to investigate the cause of the ghost’s death and put it to rest.

5-5.description: Animals or animated objects speak clearly to direct the adventurers toward the situation.

4-4.description: 地面因雨水、打翻的油或其他液體而濕滑。進行一次[[/save dex dc=10]]豁免。豁免失敗時，你陷入&Reference[Prone]{伏地}狀態。

2-2.description: 人群擋住了你的去路。進行一次[[/save str dc=10]]、[[/save dex dc=10]]或[[/save cha dc=10]]豁免（由你選擇）以穿越人群。豁免失敗時，該人群對你而言視為10呎的&Reference[Difficult Terrain]{困難地形}。

6-6.description: 你必須急轉彎以避免撞上無法通行的東西。進行一次[[/save dex dc=10]]豁免以完成轉彎。豁免失敗時，你撞上堅硬的東西，並承受[[/damage 1d4 type=bludgeoning]]傷害。

3-3.description: 一片由木桶、板條箱或類似障礙物組成的迷陣擋在你的路上。進行一次[[/save dex dc=10]]或[[/save int dc=10]]豁免（由你選擇）以穿過迷陣。豁免失敗時，該迷陣對你而言視為10呎的&Reference[Difficult Terrain]{困難地形}。

1-1.description: 一輛推車或其他大型障礙物擋住了你的去路。進行一次[[/save dex dc=10]]豁免以越過障礙物。豁免失敗時，該障礙物對你而言視為10呎的&Reference[Difficult Terrain]{困難地形}。

5-5.description: 你遇上一場正在進行的鬥毆。進行一次[[/save str dc=15]]、[[/save dex dc=15]]或[[/save cha dc=15]]豁免（由你選擇）以不受阻礙地通過鬥毆者。豁免失敗時，你承受[[/damage 2d4 type=bludgeoning]]傷害，且該鬥毆者對你而言視為10呎的&Reference[Difficult Terrain]{困難地形}。

20-20.description: Hurled to a random destination on the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.content.JournalEntry.dmgCosmology0000.JournalEntryPage.lNqkZFfXDs9S3sft]{Astral Plane}

C9kU6Coe7d6REbHc.description: Blown to a location in the Border Ethereal overlapping a random plane. This result will automatically roll on the Ethereal Curtains table.

1-12.description: Extended journey. Each character in a group traveling together makes a [[/save cha 15]] saving throw. If at least half the group succeeds, travel is delayed by [[/r 1d10]] hours. Otherwise, the journey’s travel time is doubled.

7-9.description: 該物品能說一種或多種語言。

1-6.description: 該物品透過向攜帶或持用該物品的生物傳遞情緒來溝通。

10-10.description: 該物品能說一種或多種語言。此外，該物品還能與任何攜帶或持用該物品的生物以心靈感應溝通。

11-11.description: Plane: Para-elemental Plane of Magma. Curtain Color: Maroon

9-9.description: Plane: Para-elemental Plane of Ash. Curtain Color: Dark gray

12-12.description: Plane: Para-elemental Plane of Ooze. Curtain Color: Chocolate

5-5.description: Plane: Elemental Plane of Air. Curtain Color: Pale blue

6-6.description: Plane: Elemental Plane of Earth. Curtain Color: Chestnut

8-8.description: Plane: Elemental Plane of Water. Curtain Color: Green

7-7.description: Plane: Elemental Plane of Fire. Curtain Color: Orange

10-10.description: Plane: Para-elemental Plane of Ice. Curtain Color: Aquamarine

13-16.description: Lost; at the end of the travel time, the characters arrive at a location other than the intended destination

17-20.description: Sent through a random color pool (roll on the Astral Color Pools table)

9-12.description: Blown astray; add 3d10 days to travel time

4-4.description: Abandoned. Most of the dungeon is deserted. Dexterity (Stealth) checks have Disadvantage because any sounds stand out as unusual.

3-3.description: Neglected. One dungeon hazard—such as brown mold, green slime, or yellow mold (see @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.content.JournalEntry.dmgDmsToolbox000.JournalEntryPage.lVkdQivhFHqVmxg7]{Hazards})—is abundant.

1-1.description: Perilous. The area is dangerously worn and prone to collapse. Any impacts or damage to the structure, including from spells and other areas of effect, have a 50 percent chance of causing a collapse.

2-2.description: Crumbling. Areas within the dungeon section are choked with rubble and have a 50 percent chance of being &Reference[Difficult Terrain]. &Reference[Half Cover] and hiding places are plentiful.

6-6.description: Thriving. The dungeon is heavily populated. Any loud noises draw the attention of nearby creatures.

5-5.description: Secure. Ability checks made to break down doors, open locks, or carry out similar activities have Disadvantage.

4-4.description: The adventurers race to the site where a villain is bringing a master plan to its conclusion, arriving just as that plan is about to be completed.

10-10.description: Just when the characters think the main threat is defeated, it transforms into a different monster or a more powerful form.

8-8.description: The dungeon begins to collapse while a villain attempts to escape in the chaos.

5-5.description: A villain and two or three lieutenants perform separate rites in a large room. The adventurers must disrupt all the rites.

3-3.description: The actions of the adventurers or a villain result in a cataclysmic event that the adventurers must escape.

7-7.description: A portal opens to another plane of existence. Creatures on the other side spill out, forcing the adventurers to close the portal while dealing with a villain at the same time.

2-2.description: The adventurers chase a villain while dodging obstacles designed to thwart them, leading to a final confrontation in the villain’s refuge.

6-6.description: An ally betrays the adventurers as they’re about to achieve their goal. (Use this climax carefully, and don’t overuse it.)

1-1.description: The adventurers confront a villain and a group of minions in a battle to the finish.

9-9.description: The adventurers must choose whether to pursue a fleeing villain or save an NPC they care about or a group of innocents.

5-5.description: Powerful monster

1-1.description: Respected, fair, and just leader or council

Creator or Intended User.name: 魔法物品的製作者或預設使用者

11-12.description: 【精靈】該物品重量為正常的一半，上面點綴著象徵自然的符號：樹葉、藤蔓、星辰等。

8-8.description: 【土元素】這件物品可能以石頭製成。其上的任何布料或皮革部分都嵌滿了精細打磨的小石粒。

7-7.description: 【氣元素】該物品重量為正常的一半，摸起來像是空心的。若其以布料製成，則輕薄透明。

15-15.description: 【巨人】該物品比正常尺寸更大，是由巨人製作給體型較小的盟友使用。

5-6.description: 【矮人】該物品堅固耐用，設計中融入了矮人符文。其可能與某個希望將其歸還祖傳大廳的氏族有關。

2-2.description: 【天界生物】該物品重量為正常的一半，上面刻有羽翼、太陽與星辰的圖案。邪魔會對其感到厭惡。

13-13.description: 【精類】該物品以最上等的材料精巧製成，在月光下散發蒼白的光輝，並在半徑5呎內投下微光光照。該物品上的任何金屬皆為銀或秘銀，而非鐵或鋼。

17-19.description: 【人類】該物品創造於某個覆滅的人類王國的全盛時期，或與傳說中的某位人類有緊密關聯。其上可能刻有失傳語言的文字，或意義已隨歲月消逝的符號。

9-9.description: 【火元素】該物品摸起來溫熱，任何金屬部分均以黑鐵打造。火焰圖樣覆蓋其表面。

1-1.description: 【異怪】該物品年代久遠，乍看之下像是被黏液覆蓋。

10-10.description: 【水元素】這件物品上的皮革或布料由有光澤的魚鱗取代，金屬部分則由貝殼與加工過的珊瑚（硬度不輸任何金屬）取代。

4-4.description: 【龍類】這件物品鑲有取自龍之寶藏的貴金屬與寶石。當位於一隻龍類120呎內時，其會變熱。

16-16.description: 【侏儒】該物品被製作得看似平凡且用舊了。其可能還包含齒輪與機械零件，即使這些並非其功能所必需。

20-20.description: 【不死生物】該物品帶有象徵死亡的標誌，例如骨頭與骷髏，且可能以屍體的部位製成。摸起來冰冷。

14-14.description: 【邪魔】該物品以鐵或角製成，任何布料或皮革部分皆以邪魔的皮製成。其表面刻有奸笑的臉孔或邪惡的符文。天界生物會對其感到厭惡。

3-3.description: 【蘿絲信徒】該物品重量為正常的一半，上面刻有蜘蛛與蛛網的圖案，以表達對蘿絲的敬意。

85-88.description: 與該神器同調期間，其他生物位於你300呎內時，無法進行短休或長休。

89-92.description: 與該神器同調期間，你會殺死你所觸碰的任何非魔法且非生物的植物。

77-80.description: 與該神器同調期間，所有位於你10呎內的聖水都會被摧毀。

25-32.description: 與該神器同調期間，當你與該神器相距超過10呎時，你陷入目盲狀態。

17-24.description: 與該神器同調期間，你對毒素傷害具有易傷。

93-100.description: 與該神器同調期間，位於你30呎內、挑戰等級為6或以下的野獸對你敵對。

49-66.description: 與該神器同調期間，你的外貌會依DM的決定而改變。

81-84.description: 與該神器同調期間，位於你30呎內的非魔法火焰會被熄滅。

73-76.description: 每當你在與該神器同調期間觸碰非魔法的寶石或藝術品時，該寶石或藝術品的價值減半。每件物品只會受此影響一次。

41-48.description: 與該神器同調期間，你失去所有嗅覺。

67-72.description: 與該神器同調期間，你會散發出10呎內都能察覺的酸臭味。

1-8.description: 與該神器同調期間，你進行任何使用力量或體質的屬性檢定或豁免時具有劣勢。

33-40.description: 與該神器同調期間，當你與該神器相距超過10呎時，你陷入耳聾狀態。

9-16.description: 與該神器同調期間，你進行智力、感知與魅力豁免時具有劣勢。

1-1.description: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgRingOfResista.ActiveEffect.dBl3gfYXWn7YguDb]{Acid (Pearl)}

5-5.description: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgRingOfResista.ActiveEffect.96wcenml9tk62g37]{Lightning (Citrine)}

10-10.description: 【聖殿騎士】該物品試圖保衛某位特定神祇的僕從與利益。

1-1.description: 【排異】該物品試圖擊敗或摧毀陣營與其完全相反者。這類物品絕不會是中立。

5-5.description: 【破壞者】該物品渴望破壞，並慫恿其使用者隨意爭鬥。

2-2.description: 【制造災禍】該物品試圖阻撓或摧毀某種特定類型的生物，例如構裝體、邪魔或不死生物。

6-6.description: 【尋求榮耀】該物品試圖為其使用者贏得名聲或惡名，藉此成為世上最偉大的魔法物品。

4-4.description: 【尋求天命】該物品相信自己與其持有者在未來的事件中將扮演關鍵角色。

9-9.description: 【尋求知己】該物品尋找另一件智能魔法物品，或許是與其自身相似的物品。

8-8.description: 【保護者】該物品試圖保衛某種特定的生物，例如精靈或狼人。

7-7.description: 【尋求知識】該物品渴求知識，或決心解開謎團、探知秘密，或破解晦澀的預言。

19-27.description: 當你與該神器同調時，你承受8d10心靈傷害。

91-96.description: 該神器囚禁著一隻死亡史拉蟾。每次你與該神器同調時，該史拉蟾有10%的機率逃脫，隨後出現在盡可能靠近你的未佔據空間，並攻擊你。

97-100.description: 與該神器同調期間，你無法花費生命骰或恢復生命值。

10-18.description: 當你與該神器同調時，你隨機一項屬性值降低2，最低為3。高等復原術法術可以恢復該屬性值。

55-63.description: 該神器會稀釋位於其10呎內的藥水，使這些藥水失去魔法。

1-9.description: 與該神器同調期間，你無法與其他魔法物品同調。當你與該神器同調時，你與其他魔法物品的同調會立即結束。

73-81.description: 與該神器同調期間，由DM選擇的某一類型生物（類人生物除外）始終對你敵對。

28-36.description: 當你首次與該神器同調時，該神器會給予你一項由DM決定的任務。在你完成該任務之前，你無法使用該神器的任何屬性。

82-90.description: 與該神器同調期間，你對所有傷害具有易傷。

64-72.description: 該神器會抹去位於其10呎內的卷軸，使這些卷軸失去魔法。

37-45.description: 每次你與該神器同調時，都有10%的機率引起某位神祇的注意，該神祇會派遣化身來從你手中奪走該神器。該化身的陣營與其創造者相同，並使用至高天的數值面板。化身一旦取得該神器便會消失。

46-54.description: 每次你與該神器同調時，你必須成功通過一次DC 10的體質豁免，否則會因衝擊而死亡。若你死亡，你會立即轉變為一隻受DM控制的屍妖，並必須保護該神器。

100-100.description: Only one potion works, but its effects are permanent. Choose the simplest effect to make permanent or the one that seems the most fun. For example, a Potion of Healing might increase the drinker’s Hit Point maximum by [[/roll 2d4 + 2]], or a Potion of Invisibility might give the drinker the Invisible condition indefinitely. At your discretion, a Dispel Magic spell or similar magic might end this lasting effect.

91-99.description: Both potions work, but the numerical effects and duration of one potion are doubled. If neither potion has anything to double in this way, they work normally.

26-35.description: Both potions work, but with their numerical effects and durations halved. If a potion has no numerical effect and no duration, it instead loses its effect.

2-8.description: Both potions lose their effects, and the mixture becomes an ingested poison of your choice (see @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.content.JournalEntry.dmgDmsToolbox000.JournalEntryPage.UfAEdm3LbTzvQHC5]{Poison}).

The Moonblade gains the Thrown property with a normal range of 20 feet and a long range of 60 feet. Each time you throw the weapon, it flies back to your hand after the attack.

86-95.description:
@UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgMoonblade0000.ActiveEffect.rzsbnjT5QiK2Jq8E]
You can take a Bonus Action to cause the Moonblade to flash brightly. Each other creature that is within 30 feet of you and not behind Total Cover must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have the Blinded condition for 1 minute. A creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. You can’t use this property again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

1-60.description:
@UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgMoonblade0000.ActiveEffect.o2IcKz2aAooQr7EK]
Increase the weapon’s bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls by 1, to a maximum of +3. Reroll if the Moonblade already has a +3 bonus.

61-75.description:
@UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgMoonblade0000.ActiveEffect.vwQstbhAl6CdxUeN]
When you hit with an attack roll using the Moonblade , you deal an extra 1d6 Force damage. Each time the weapon gains this property after the first, the extra damage increases by 1d6, to a maximum of 3d6. Reroll if the Moonblade already deals an extra 3d6 Force damage on a hit.

100-100.description:
@UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgMoonblade0000.ActiveEffect.Qzkx9WVqILq2hG5c]
You can take a Magic action to conjure a spectral entity that resembles a shadowy elf if you don’t already have one serving you. The entity appears in an unoccupied space within 120 feet of you. It uses the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.actors.Actor.QGcQYZbVl4bWzi4E]{Shadow} stat block with these changes: it is a Fey, has a Neutral alignment, and doesn’t create new shadows. You control this entity, deciding how it acts and moves. It remains until it drops to 0 Hit Points or you dismiss it as a Magic action.

1-1.description: When magic fails to revive a dead person, the only solution is to venture to the Outer Planes to find the person’s spirit and either release it from some prison or convince the person to return to life.

10-10.description: An item of legend is being sold at auction in Sigil, the City of Brass, or some other planar metropolis.

5-5.description: A devil has tricked an angel into meddling in the Blood War, and the angel seeks mortal aid.

8-8.description: A titan is imprisoned on an Outer Plane. The characters might be trying to stop those who seek to release it, or they might want to release it to help defend the world from a greater threat.

7-7.description: A foolhardy knight carried a holy weapon on a doomed mission into the Nine Hells, and the powers of Mount Celestia want the weapon and the knight’s remains retrieved.

6-6.description: A ancestor of one of the characters must be convinced to bless the character before the full power of the character’s bloodline can be unleashed.

2-2.description: People who venture into the woods keep accidentally wandering into the Feywild or the Shadowfell. They might never return, return with no sense of how much time has passed, or return dramatically changed.

9-9.description: To prove themselves worthy of an even greater quest, the characters are sent to slay a horrible monster, win the favor of a powerful planar being, negotiate peace between two warring planar factions, or retrieve a long-lost item on another plane.

3-3.description: A long-dead oracle is the only one who knows how a terrible prophecy might be averted, but the cataclysmic fulfillment of the prophecy has already begun.

4-4.description: A god has stopped answering prayers and won’t respond to any Commune spell.
